scope: Production browser bundle and its direct Vue entry point. Development tools and non-emitted compiler, server-rendering and type-only dependencies are excluded. Native application and media runtime dependencies are documented separately.
auditMethod: Vite production build with build.write=false; collect node_modules IDs from every emitted JavaScript chunk.modules. Match package versions and archive URLs against package-lock.json. Original license bytes are copied or reused without rewriting. Vendored code inside emitted modules is audited separately.
